description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Reks)] to the user, grants [XII Resonance +3% Boost] to all FF12 allies

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Reks)
description.text: Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 2 additional times, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the character's row after using Lightning attacks

description.name: XII Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% if the character's Realm is XII

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II (Reks)]
